operational_failures.failure: The first read-only skill inventory wrapper piped directly from a foreach block and PowerShell rejected the empty pipeline element before reading a skill.
operational_failures.recovery: Materialize the inventory rows first and pipe the resulting array only after the loop.

operational_failures.failure: The first read-only D-drive worktree inventory used the same foreach-to-pipeline wrapper shape and failed before a repository query ran.
operational_failures.recovery: Materialize repository inventory rows in an explicit array and then format the array.

operational_failures.failure: A combined four-skill display exceeded the wrapper output budget and truncated part of the Family Index guidance.
operational_failures.recovery: Read every required skill separately in bounded line windows through literal EOF.

operational_failures.failure: A combined current-workflow display exceeded its output budget before all 210 assignment rows were visible.
operational_failures.recovery: Read the v15 workflow in three nonoverlapping bounded windows and parse the complete JSON independently.

operational_failures.failure: The first line-numbered display of Avelin's minified phase controller truncated long executable lines.
operational_failures.recovery: Read the exact UTF-8 controller in contiguous character windows through EOF and retain the first truncated display at zero credit.

operational_failures.failure: The first bounded definition-oracle smoke failed to load after a cache edit left one closing parenthesis missing in the parking-cache setter.
operational_failures.recovery: Correct only the malformed cache expression, retain the failed load at zero credit, and rerun the same preplanning smoke before any plan freeze.

operational_failures.failure: The first exact staged diff check found one extra blank line at the end of operational-failures.json.
operational_failures.recovery: Remove only the extra blank line, refresh the plan manifest binding, retain a separate correction receipt, and rerun bounded stage validation without regenerating contracts or executing x1.

operational_failures.failure: The first corrected plan was pretty-formatted to 159,640 whitespace-delimited words and failed the 100,000-word document ceiling.
operational_failures.recovery: Mechanically compact the unchanged JSON semantics, retain the failed validation at zero credit, and bind the compacted plan in a second correction receipt.

operational_failures.failure: The first external correction-record patch used a repository-style nested owner/phase path instead of the phase bank's exact single-folder name and failed before changing a file.
operational_failures.recovery: Resolve the literal existing bank path and apply the pending records there without retrying any plan or domain execution.
